Bhudism creator were far in spiritual researching, everything i know en had to discover myself im always suprised that its already recorded in some buddist text book. The mistake budist path seeker of old was accepting students en never drilling in the students head that  the student should surpass the master. so at some point student started looking up to the master then eventually they kept being behind.

Death is not hard to understand, its just we are too messy to overcome obstacles already laid to ensure we dont easily overcome them, but i always said so long its not impossible then everything can be archived, then again i dont believe in impossible in the first place also. any when it comes down to it we enter spirituality because death we dislike for whatever reason it always boils down to dying even if reincanating after dying is to follow once more eventually. There are very specific types of who goes to light or dark entrance, light is mostly for the religious, all others go to the void but majority remains unaware at the void, en no you dont need to die to experince this things, en yes in darkness there are other beings, en yes you can enter or exit darkness as you will provided your will is capable, everyone has potential to grow their will en intent such that it can force menifest in inspirit world en yes same can happen in physicall world its just some it seem physical element require more force to move. 

Im going to sleep now body exhausted en beings are waiting for me in spirit world as usual, yes i dont dream I go to where the dead are each time i close my eyes, been  so for so long, yes no its not that i fear death nor that I can resist it but that spirit world is not perfect yet but now almost so, thats because we are battling in that place en we almost about to win en gain control en with that everyone can finally be free, That how we chose to approach liberation of all us, take over spirit world forcefully obviusly rather than deal with stupid humans who rather keep putting heads in sand we saw its easier to just win the paradise for them then allow them to be just free because we acknoledge we are one en connected, hence one of us can make all of us free but all of us cant really be free if one of us is still shackled.

Yeah, this is why i am as i am, i go with strengh en take because i dont see why should i be subjected to thing i never conciusly chose, even if i once did since i dont remeber now then i wont subject my self to anything, hence my path is of destruction pure en dark also of creation pure en dark, hence my path is of limitless. I do not follow anyone, after all what makes them worthy en me not worthy, en what makes who ever choose who is worthy worthy to choose in first place, even if they are worthy so long i never recognised them as such then they are not worthy. This is absolute battle path, en i dont expect mediocracy in me neither do i tolerate it in others, but i acknowledge once outmost trying efforts en i appreciate it more, because life has potential to be incredible en nothing is worthy to me than observing life grow with everything it has, no matter the odd laid against it.
